name: Convex and Concave
source:
The 6th Holy Grail War, held beneath the Moon Cell.
The opponent was a Caster of unknown identity.
Saber pressed the attack relentlessly, but a single Noble Phantasm from Caster stole her consciousness.
When she awoke, she was trapped within an inescapable Reality Marble…

[Translated from the [url=http://assault.sakura.ne.jp/eternal/cac/index.htm]official site[/url]]
translation:
在Moon Cell之下举行的第六次圣杯战争。
对手是一位身份不明的Caster。
Saber毫不停歇地猛攻，却被Caster的一件宝具夺去了意识。
醒来之时，她已被困在无处可逃的固有结界之中……

[译自[url=http://assault.sakura.ne.jp/eternal/cac/index.htm]官方网站[/url]]
